description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Nepal for Exemption from Visa Requirement for Holders of Diplomatic, Official and Service Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Recognizing the importance of the friendly cooperation existing between Sri Lanka and the Government of Nepal, a consensus has been reached by the relevant parties of Sri Lanka and Nepal to enter into an Agreement between the two parties with a view to facilitating travel between the two countries for official purposes and removing unnecessary hindrances in obtaining visas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to sign an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Nepal to enable holders of Diplomatic, Official and Service passports of both countries to enter, travel through and stay in the territory of the other Contracting Party for a period not exceeding 30 days without obtaining a visa, was approved by the Cabinet.
